```{r run-enriched-model-b, include=FALSE}
# Set Model B (focused specification)
MODEL_STRUCTURE <<- 1

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/06_parametric_survival_analysis.R"))
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/07_basecase_input_parameters.R"))
}))

biomarker_labels <- c(
  crp = "CRP-positive",
  tmb_braf = "TMB/BRAF-positive",
  tlr = "TLR-positive"
)

enriched_results <- data.frame()

for (biomarker in names(biomarker_labels)) {
  # Get enriched population predictions
  if (!is.null(predictions[[biomarker]]$biomarker_positive)) {
    bm_pos_os <- predictions[[biomarker]]$biomarker_positive$os
    bm_pos_pfs <- predictions[[biomarker]]$biomarker_positive$pfs
  } else {
    next
  }

  ctrl_os <- predictions$control$os
  ctrl_pfs <- predictions$control$pfs

  # Discount factors
  dr_costs <- l_params_base$dr_costs
  dr_effects <- l_params_base$dr_effects
  th <- l_params_base$time_horizon

  v_dw_c <- 1 / (1 + dr_costs)^(seq(0, th) / 52)
  v_dw_e <- 1 / (1 + dr_effects)^(seq(0, th) / 52)

  # Enriched experimental arm (biomarker+ on FLOX-nivo)
  exp_pf <- bm_pos_pfs
  exp_os <- bm_pos_os
  exp_p <- pmax(exp_os - exp_pf, 0)

  exp_qaly <- sum((exp_pf * l_params_base$u_np + exp_p * l_params_base$u_p) * v_dw_e) * l_params_base$cl

  exp_cost <- sum((
    l_params_base$l_nivo * l_params_base$c_drug_nivo +
    l_params_base$l_FLOX_exp * l_params_base$c_drug_FLOX +
    l_params_base$l_CT * l_params_base$c_test_CT +
    l_params_base$l_blood * l_params_base$c_test_blood +
    l_params_base$l_visit * l_params_base$c_other_visit
  ) * exp_pf * v_dw_c) * l_params_base$cl +
    l_params_base$c_other_baseline + l_params_base$c_other_last

  # Add biomarker test costs
  if (biomarker == "tmb_braf") {
    exp_cost <- exp_cost + l_params_base$c_test_NGS
  } else {
    exp_cost <- exp_cost + l_params_base$c_test_blood
  }

  # Enriched control arm (biomarker+ on FLOX only)
  ctrl_pf <- ctrl_pfs
  ctrl_p <- pmax(ctrl_os - ctrl_pf, 0)

  ctrl_qaly <- sum((ctrl_pf * l_params_base$u_np + ctrl_p * l_params_base$u_p) * v_dw_e) * l_params_base$cl

  ctrl_cost <- sum((
    l_params_base$l_FLOX_control * l_params_base$c_drug_FLOX +
    l_params_base$l_CT * l_params_base$c_test_CT +
    l_params_base$l_blood * l_params_base$c_test_blood +
    l_params_base$l_visit * l_params_base$c_other_visit
  ) * ctrl_pf * v_dw_c) * l_params_base$cl +
    l_params_base$c_other_baseline + l_params_base$c_other_last

  # Store both arms
  enriched_results <- rbind(enriched_results,
    data.frame(Biomarker = biomarker_labels[biomarker],
               Treatment = "FLOX",
               Cost = ctrl_cost, QALYs = ctrl_qaly,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(Biomarker = biomarker_labels[biomarker],
               Treatment = "FLOX\u2013nivo",
               Cost = exp_cost, QALYs = exp_qaly,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
}
```

```{r build-display-table, include=FALSE}
# Compute incremental results
display_data <- enriched_results %>%
  group_by(Biomarker) %>%
  summarise(
    Ctrl_Cost = Cost[Treatment == "FLOX"],
    Ctrl_QALY = QALYs[Treatment == "FLOX"],
    Exp_Cost = Cost[Treatment == "FLOX\u2013nivo"],
    Exp_QALY = QALYs[Treatment == "FLOX\u2013nivo"],
    Inc_Cost = Exp_Cost - Ctrl_Cost,
    Inc_QALY = Exp_QALY - Ctrl_QALY,
    ICER = ifelse(Inc_QALY > 0, Inc_Cost / Inc_QALY, NA),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Reshape for manuscript layout: two rows per biomarker (FLOX then FLOX-nivo)
display_fmt <- enriched_results %>%
  mutate(
    Cost_fmt = sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(Cost), big.mark = ",")),
    QALY_fmt = sprintf("%.2f", QALYs)
  )

# Add incremental columns (only on experimental rows)
display_fmt <- display_fmt %>%
  left_join(
    display_data %>%
      select(Biomarker, Inc_Cost, Inc_QALY, ICER) %>%
      mutate(Treatment = "FLOX\u2013nivo"),
    by = c("Biomarker", "Treatment")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Inc_Cost_fmt = ifelse(is.na(Inc_Cost), "\u2014",
                          sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(Inc_Cost), big.mark = ","))),
    Inc_QALY_fmt = ifelse(is.na(Inc_QALY), "\u2014",
                          sprintf("%.2f", Inc_QALY)),
    ICER_fmt = case_when(
      is.na(Inc_QALY) ~ "\u2014",
      Inc_QALY <= 0 & Inc_Cost > 0 ~ "Dominated",
      Inc_QALY > 0 ~ sprintf("\u20AC%s/QALY", format(round(ICER), big.mark = ",")),
      TRUE ~ "Dominant"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Biomarker, Treatment, Cost_fmt, QALY_fmt,
         Inc_Cost_fmt, Inc_QALY_fmt, ICER_fmt)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(display_fmt,
      caption = "Table 6: Biomarker-enriched population results (Model B)",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Biomarker subgroup", "Treatment", "Cost (\u20AC)", "QALYs",
                     "\u0394 Cost (\u20AC)", "\u0394 QALYs", "ICER"),
      align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 5))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 11) %>%
  pack_rows(index = table(display_fmt$Biomarker)[unique(display_fmt$Biomarker)]) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Biomarker-enriched analysis restricts cohort to biomarker-positive patients only.",
      "Costs and QALYs discounted at 4%. Dominated = more costly and less effective.",
      "Under Model C, TMB/BRAF-enriched yielded ICER \u20AC323,878/QALY; TLR-enriched \u20AC1,242,396/QALY.",
      "Under Model A, TMB/BRAF-enriched yielded ICER \u20AC1,625,723/QALY."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```
